name: Silver Tongue (Greater)
text:
This tongue-shaped silver trinket typically dangles from a silver chain. It seems to catch the light wherever it is affixed. When affixed to armor or a weapon with any metal components, it makes those pieces gleam brightly. The spell DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 34.
- Armor You gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws against auditory and linguistic effects.

- Weapon After you cast a mental spell by Activating the silver tongue, you gain a +3 item bonus to Intimidation checks to demoralize until the end of your next turn.
